description: Unit test class 'ProcessorTest' for testing the tree processing and modification functionalities within the 'Todaymade\Daux' documentation generator tool. The test sets up a virtual filesystem, configures documentation tree building, manipulates the tree structure (adding, removing, and renaming nodes), and asserts the expected tree structure and node properties.

classes.name: ProcessorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the 'Processor' class's functionality in tree manipulation within the Daux documentation generator.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Recursively serializes a node and its children into an array with 'title' and 'url' entries, used for asserting the integrity of the tree structure.

methods.name: testAddPage
methods.description: Tests the process of building, manipulating, and verifying a documentation tree structure, including adding new pages, deleting nodes, and checking node properties.
